objective: R2 corrige Gate0 READ_ONLY de Tablajeria agregando queries explicitas al sql_readonly_audit. Auditar arquitectura tecnica canonica V1 contra repositorio real y metadata SQL disponible de solo lectura. No modificar archivos. Publicar reporte completo en worker/results.

queries.name: schema_tablajeria_objects
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (300) SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc, o.create_date, o.modify_date FROM sys.objects o WHERE LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%tablaj%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%tablaje%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%lote%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%plantilla%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%merma%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%rendimiento%' ORDER BY schema_name, object_name

queries.name: schema_canonical_domain_objects
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (500) SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o WHERE LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%empresa%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%unidad%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%sucursal%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%almacen%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%producto%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%insumo%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%inventario%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%movimiento%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%kardex%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%costo%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%compra%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%contab%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%usuario%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%rol%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%permiso%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%auditoria%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%workflow%' ORDER BY schema_name, object_name

queries.name: schema_relevant_columns
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (500) SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, c.name AS column_name, t.name AS data_type, c.max_length, c.precision, c.scale, c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c INNER JOIN sys.objects o ON c.object_id = o.object_id INNER JOIN sys.types t ON c.user_type_id = t.user_type_id WHERE LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%tablaj%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%inventario%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%producto%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%movimiento%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%costo%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%compra%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%usuario%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%empresa%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%unidad%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%sucursal%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%almacen%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%lote%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%fechaoperacion%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%cantidad%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%peso%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%costo%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%merma%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%rendimiento%' ORDER BY schema_name, object_name, c.column_id

queries.name: schema_tablajeria_foreign_keys
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (300) fk.name AS fk_name, SCHEMA_NAME(parent_o.schema_id) AS parent_schema, parent_o.name AS parent_object, SCHEMA_NAME(ref_o.schema_id) AS referenced_schema, ref_o.name AS referenced_object FROM sys.foreign_keys fk INNER JOIN sys.objects parent_o ON fk.parent_object_id = parent_o.object_id INNER JOIN sys.objects ref_o ON fk.referenced_object_id = ref_o.object_id WHERE LOWER(parent_o.name) LIKE '%tablaj%' OR LOWER(parent_o.name) LIKE '%lote%' OR LOWER(parent_o.name) LIKE '%plantilla%' OR LOWER(ref_o.name) LIKE '%tablaj%' OR LOWER(ref_o.name) LIKE '%producto%' OR LOWER(ref_o.name) LIKE '%inventario%' OR LOWER(ref_o.name) LIKE '%almacen%' OR LOWER(ref_o.name) LIKE '%usuario%' ORDER BY parent_schema, parent_object, fk_name

queries.name: schema_tablajeria_indexes
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (300) SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, i.name AS index_name, i.type_desc, i.is_unique, i.is_primary_key FROM sys.indexes i INNER JOIN sys.objects o ON i.object_id = o.object_id WHERE i.name IS NOT NULL AND (LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%tablaj%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%lote%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%plantilla%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%inventario%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%movimiento%') ORDER BY schema_name, object_name, index_name

queries.name: schema_modules_references
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (300) SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o LEFT JOIN sys.sql_modules m ON o.object_id = m.object_id WHERE LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%tablaj%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%parrilla%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%foto%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%inventario%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%costo%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%contab%' OR LOWER(m.definition) LIKE '%tablaj%' OR LOWER(m.definition) LIKE '%operaciones_tablaje%' OR LOWER(m.definition) LIKE '%fechaoperacion%' ORDER BY schema_name, object_name

queries.name: schema_rbac_permissions
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (300) DB_NAME() AS database_name, dp.name AS principal_name, dp.type_desc AS principal_type, perm.class_desc, perm.permission_name, perm.state_desc, OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(perm.major_id) AS object_schema, OBJECT_NAME(perm.major_id) AS object_name FROM sys.database_permissions perm INNER JOIN sys.database_principals dp ON perm.grantee_principal_id = dp.principal_id WHERE LOWER(dp.name) LIKE '%tablaj%' OR LOWER(dp.name) LIKE '%hub%' OR LOWER(perm.permission_name) LIKE '%select%' OR LOWER(OBJECT_NAME(perm.major_id)) LIKE '%tablaj%' ORDER BY principal_name, permission_name, object_schema, object_name
